name: HumHub
description: Open source social network and collaboration platform for internal team communities.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      HUMHUB_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      HUMHUB_DB_NAME: humhub
      HUMHUB_DB_USER: humhub
      HUMHUB_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.HUMHUB_DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/uploads:/var/www/localhost/htdocs/uploads
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: humhub
      MYSQL_USER: humhub
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.HUMHUB_DB_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.HUMHUB_DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
